dolls.bio:
A Doll with a prickly exterior but who has a sensitive soul. She often ends up forcing herself to do things she's poor at and hating herself as a result. She enjoys listening to late-night radio channels, and gets extremely irritable if she doesn't replenish her sugar levels in time. She hates violence, but considers weapons to be civilized and effective problem-solving tools, so using a gun doesn't fall under that definition.
"Consuming too much sugar will make me malfunction, but I'll scrap myself on the spot if I don't get any right now, so I guess I should have some... Nom. Want some too, Commander?"

dolls.bio: A tactical Doll who is outwardly cold but possesses a delicate heart. While she might seem to agree with others without much thought, the truth is that she takes their opinions to heart and tries her best to satisfy them. She notices little details and reactions often overlooked by others, and she is quite sensitive to her surroundings. However, this also leads to her being influenced easily by the environment. \n"I once thought time would change many things... However, it seems you haven't changed, and neither have we... It is only the world that changes every day."

An energetic and active Doll who loves to fight. Her thought process is simpler than most and she prefers doing things over thinking about them. She trusts her friends unconditionally and obeys your orders without question.

dolls.bio:
From a Cyber Media performance doll, to a Griffin tactical doll, to a B.R.I.E.F. bounty hunter — Eagletta has never stopped exploring in the play that is her search for herself. However difficult the production, independent and steadfast as she is, she always performs the calm, dependable role well.
"I may not be under the spotlight anymore, but I still consider myself an actress. It's just that now, my stage is the whole world."

dolls.bio:
Faelynn's memories are heavy with painful, suppressed secrets, yet a bright streak still shows through her spirit — every dark cloud in her mind is lit by an innocent, warming sun.
"Master, no matter how long you're away, I... I'll be a good girl and wait for you to come home!"

dolls.bio: A Doll whose appearance contrasts greatly with her personality. Small in stature yet imposing, she carries a gun in one hand and an axe in another, creating a presence that would scare off most people. However, if you are willing to look past her appearance and get to understand her better, you will find that, behind her intolerant expression and irritable tone lies a delicate, sensitive soul. She too, is awaiting your warmth.

dolls.bio: A passionate and responsible Doll who's devoted to the art of dancing. A compliment from the Commander set her on the path to becoming a dancer, and she founded the dancing troupe called "Sparkle Squad" to provide wandering Dolls with a place to call home and thus do justice to her position as a veteran Doll. She has never slacked off in her quest to perfect her art; diligence and willingness to learn are the cornerstones of her efforts while never giving up and keeping her eyes on the goals are the secret of her success. Don't question it, just trust her, because when she says she'll do it, she means it. "Keep up with the beat! Let's blow the roof off this place!"

dolls.bio: A Doll who was "reborn" from Leva's neural logs, she's a little ball of sunshine and a decisive, resilient fighter. While her looks and personality are practically the same as the Doll she was modeled on, Lainie knows that her simulated past doesn't define her, and her future holds limitless possibilities. There is plenty of empty space in her neural cloud, just waiting to be filled with new experiences. She wants to cherish her bonds with Leva, you, and everyone else.\n"Commander, let's go out and get some sun today~"

dolls.bio:
Gentle and accepting like the spring wind, sharp and aloof, like cold steel; the former is called Phaetusa, while the latter is Sweeper. Of these two souls who inhabit the same frame, one is humanity's finest guardian, while the other is a fighting corpse from Sangvis Ferri Manufacturing.

dolls.bio: The first impression she gives others is that of an impatient Doll, often getting anxious when communicating with others. This only gets more obvious after her words are misunderstood, sometimes driving her to her wits' end and causing her to hyperfocus on irrelevant issues. However, this is simply because she doesn't know how to properly express herself. Those who take the time to understand her will come to realize how sensitive and careful she is, as well as her perfectionist attitude toward her work. \n"...Keep smiling, don't glare at people, keep smiling... I must look really fierce now, don't I? I'm still learning how to smile, so please be patient."

dolls.bio: A pure-hearted and innocent Tactical Doll who forever holds on to a childlike heart. She's incredibly strong and can't keep her hands off all things cute. Despite being a celebrity in the world of toys and collectibles, Lewis doesn't crave recognition or personal gain; she cares only about bringing joy to others and protecting the smiles of children. As a toymaker, she wants to pass on happiness to the future through her toy designs, and as a Tactical Doll, she defends that future with her weapon.

dolls.bio: She's used to centering herself when she speaks and is quite harsh on her teammates. However, she deeply cherishes her friends and works hard to help everyone around her. She places great faith in her powers of discernment and is eager to pass judgement on people and things, while also taking action to uphold her sense of justice. She's very gentle deep down, but is bad at expressing her concern for others. This is a source of frustration for her and she needs her friends' acceptance and understanding. When her tough front is pierced, she reveals an unexpectedly cute side to her.

dolls.bio: Kind and gentle in appearance, she is also highly skilled at manipulating rules and exploiting loopholes to get what she wants. dolls.bio: As both the founder and courier of "Ouka Kyuso", she is primarily active in the satellite cities and the contaminated zone around them. Together with her vehicle navigation system "colleague", they aim to make life a better place for the locals through speedy and efficient deliveries. Despite being introverted and unfortunate, her hardworking and diligent attitude has earned her the title of "Ace Courier". While she has grown into a capable professional, what truly makes her happy is the fact that she will be able to walk her future path with you by her side.\n"If all this hard work wins me praise from the Commander... Then I guess I can work a little harder?"

dolls.bio:
A reserved and cautious Tactical Doll, she is introverted, bad at expressing herself, and gets embarrassed easily. Although it isn't related to her current job, she retains a tireless drive to explore unknown fields and dabble in various skills. This passion is hidden deep beneath her calm appearance, like a buried treasure, and only a Commander with keen insight can discover her unique brilliance. 
"...I just know a little, there's no need to praise me... I'm just an ordinary Tactical Doll."

dolls.bio:
It's hard to sum up Basti's past in a single word. To those in power, it's a criminal record. In the criminal underworld, it's a horror story. And to the Commander, it's a touching love letter.

dolls.bio:
She's a Doll who's gentle and polite, kind yet resilient. She seems to have no grasp of prices or arithmetic at all, which means just about everything she uses costs a bomb. She's well-known for being a rich girl, but she is also extremely generous, because she believes that unreservedly distributing her wealth to others is her natural responsibility.
"Welcome back, Commander! Um... Do you have any expenses that need covering?"

dolls.bio:
Once the alpha of Squad Defy, she shouldered responsibility after the worst day of her life and led her comrades through their final watch, ultimately entrusting the leader's title and duties to a trusted companion while choosing another way to keep fighting. To this day she is still the AK-12 you know — but be very careful: she is more dangerous now than ever.
"A fine snow wolf uses the white snow to hide itself. I'm better — even dressed all in white, I can vanish into the dark."

dolls.bio: A member of Squad AR, she is calmer and more composed now than she once was. After M4's departure and her parting from the Commander, she came to treasure the companions at her side all the more. She is results-driven and cares little for process; taciturn and disinclined to explain herself, she is often misunderstood. Usually it is only after she has quietly given a great deal that others realise her good intentions — and that is her own gentle way of caring for people.

dolls.bio:
A lively girl who doesn't seem to have much presence. She likes hanging out in groups, but always ends up copying others and dislikes being alone. She does livestreams with Kuro when she has nothing to do, where her realistic impressions of others and natural ditziness have won her the audience's love. She sometimes does incomprehensible things in her daily life, but she's actually really good at getting along well with others and is always considerate of their feelings. During battle, she's always at the head of the pack, muttering some kind of weird incantation as she slashes through the enemy.
“Rush B! GO GO GO!"
